The '''KDD2055 short-range turbolaser rapid-fire defense battery''' was a [[turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] battery that saw use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The KDD2055 was designed for the defense of buildings and other structures.

The [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] was defended by a number of KDD2055 [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] hidden within the hospital tower's orb-like pinnacle.
